title: Light inside different media
hook: Change refractive index and predict phase speed of light.
misconception: phase speed of light doubles when refractive index doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply v = c/n to compare phase speed of light when refractive index changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a transparent nondispersive medium and fixed vacuum light speed, v = c/n. When refractive index doubles, phase speed of light becomes ½ times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model v = c/n; scaling exponent -1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a transparent nondispersive medium and fixed vacuum light speed, with a nonzero initial result. If refractive index triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on phase speed of light?
recall.why: Apply v = c/n under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 1/3.
